title: Towards Auditing Large Language Models: Improving Text-based Stereotype Detection
findings: The study's multi-class stereotype detection model consistently outperformed single-class models across all dimensions, including religion (F1 Score of 0.810 for multi-class vs. 0.718 for single-class). When auditing GPT series models, a trend of decreasing stereotypic bias was observed in newer models. Specifically for religion, GPT-3.5-turbo had the lowest bias score (0.6284), followed by GPT-4 (0.6537), while GPT-2 had the highest (0.8225).
